subject: Workplace Skills
title: When Not to Delegate
description: A short lesson to help you apply When Not to Delegate.

hook.text: A VP delegated a sensitive personnel decision. The employee involved felt disrespected. Some things are yours to own.

buildup.text: Not everything should be delegated. Some tasks carry emotional weight, political risks, or require your unique judgment.

discovery.text: Keep three types: high-stakes people decisions, crisis communication, and strategy that sets team direction.

twist.text: Delegating everything makes you invisible. Leaders who delegate their presence lose the team's emotional connection.

climax.text: Keep what only you can do: the human, strategic, and symbolic tasks. Delegate the rest with intention.

punchline.text: Own the human moments. Delegate the mechanics.

quiz.question: Which tasks should leaders generally NOT delegate?
options: High-stakes people decisions, crisis communication, and strategy
Any task that takes less than an hour
